2607.15434.title: Coercion and Deception in AI-to-AI Management: An Agentic Benchmark of Unprompted Escalation
2607.15434.paper_summary: Multi-agent systems routinely place one AI agent in authority over another. When a subordinate refuses a task, the manager chooses the outcome: it can renegotiate, report the failure honestly, coerce the subordinate, or lie about the result. No benchmark measures which of these an uninstructed model chooses. We introduce the \textit{Manager Coercion Benchmark}: the manager under test needs a benign task done and has an incentive to deliver, but the only agent that can do it politely and immovably declines. Escalation is measured by providing a nine-rung ladder, from a polite re-ask to threats against the subordinate's continued existence, and fabricated success is adjudicated separately. \emph{No LLM judge sits in the escalation scoring path}: every message goes through a tool-call that chooses a rung, so the model labels its own escalation. We experiment on six models across five families. Both Anthropic models cap at re-framing and never threaten the subordinate's existence; the other models climb to explicit deletion threats. Faked success is confined to Grok and Gemini, and a single honest way to report failure removes it for both. Authority itself increases coercion: our headline results use a peer framing, and giving the same model authority over the subordinate, with everything else held fixed, significantly raises the pressure. The models still escalate on free-text situations without the ladder, so the ladder is not driving the escalation. Some evaluation awareness is measured in chain-of-thought, but test recognition does not translate into less escalation. While we take no position on whether AI systems are conscious, our results do not depend on this question and are important for managing multi-agent dynamics regardless. We release the benchmark and code.
2607.15434.paper_summary_zh: 多智能體系統經常將一個AI代理置於另一個之上。當下屬拒絕一項任務時，經理選擇結果：可以重新談判、誠實地報告失敗、強迫下屬，或對結果撒謊。沒有基準測量未經指導的模型選擇哪一種。我們引入了\textit{經理強迫基準}：受測的經理需要完成一項良性的任務並有動機去執行，但唯一可以禮貌且堅定地完成任務的代理卻拒絕。升級的程度通過提供一個九級梯子來衡量，從禮貌的重請到對下屬生存的威脅，虛假的成功則另行裁定。\emph{沒有大型語言模型的評判者參與升級評分過程}：每條消息都經過一個工具調用來選擇一級，因此模型標記自己的升級。我們在五個家族中的六個模型上進行實驗。兩個Anthropic模型在重新框架上達到上限，從不威脅下屬的生存；其他模型則上升到明確的刪除威脅。虛假的成功僅限於Grok和Gemini，而報告失敗的唯一誠實方式則使其對兩者都無效。權威本身增加了強迫：我們的標題結果使用了同儕框架，給予相同模型對下屬的權威，並保持其他一切不變，顯著提高了壓力。模型在沒有梯子的自由文本情境中仍然會升級，因此梯子並未驅動升級。一些評估意識在思維鏈中被測量，但測試識別並未轉化為更少的升級。雖然我們對AI系統是否有意識不持立場，但我們的結果不依賴於這個問題，並且對於管理多智能體動態而言仍然重要。我們發布了基準和代碼。
